## Data Cleaning and Preprocessing

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)       # Data manipulation and visualization
library(rmarkdown)       # Dynamic document creation
library(dplyr)           # Data manipulation
library(data.table)      # Efficient data handling
library(caret)           # Machine learning utilities
library(mltools)         # One-hot encoding
library(randomForest)    # Random Forest modeling
library(pROC)            # ROC curve and AUC calculation

# Set working directory and file paths
train_data_path <- "C:/Users/Zachary Mendenhall/Desktop/Masters/MSBA Practice Project/Home Credit Default Risk/application_train.csv"
test_data_path <- "C:/Users/Zachary Mendenhall/Desktop/Masters/MSBA Practice Project/Home Credit Default Risk/application_test.csv"
bureau_data_path <- "C:/Users/Zachary Mendenhall/Desktop/Masters/MSBA Practice Project/Home Credit Default Risk/bureau.csv"

# Import datasets
train_data <- read.csv(train_data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
test_data <- read.csv(test_data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
bureau <- read.csv(bureau_data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Drop irrelevant columns
columns_to_drop <- c('APARTMENTS_MODE', 'BASEMENTAREA_MODE', 'YEARS_BEGINEXPLUATATION_MODE', 'YEARS_BUILD_MODE',
                     'COMMONAREA_MODE', 'ELEVATORS_MODE', 'ENTRANCES_MODE', 'FLOORSMAX_MODE', 'FLOORSMIN_MODE',
                     'LANDAREA_MODE', 'LIVINGAPARTMENTS_MODE', 'LIVINGAREA_MODE', 'NONLIVINGAPARTMENTS_MODE', 
                     'NONLIVINGAREA_MODE', 'APARTMENTS_MEDI', 'BASEMENTAREA_MEDI', 'YEARS_BEGINEXPLUATATION_MEDI', 
                     'YEARS_BUILD_MEDI', 'COMMONAREA_MEDI', 'ELEVATORS_MEDI', 'ENTRANCES_MEDI', 'FLOORSMAX_MEDI', 
                     'FLOORSMIN_MEDI', 'LANDAREA_MEDI', 'LIVINGAPARTMENTS_MEDI', 'LIVINGAREA_MEDI', 
                     'NONLIVINGAPARTMENTS_MEDI', 'NONLIVINGAREA_MEDI')

train_data <- train_data %>% select(-all_of(columns_to_drop))
test_data <- test_data %>% select(-all_of(columns_to_drop))

# Filter out rows with specific anomalous values
train_data <- train_data %>%
  filter(DAYS_EMPLOYED != 365243,
         OBS_30_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE != 348,
         DEF_30_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE != 34,
         OBS_60_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE != 344,
         DEF_60_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE != 24,
         AMT_REQ_CREDIT_BUREAU_QRT != 264,
         AMT_REQ_CREDIT_BUREAU_QRT != 19)

# Impute missing values for numeric columns
train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate(AMT_ANNUITY = if_else(is.na(AMT_ANNUITY), mean(AMT_ANNUITY, na.rm = TRUE), AMT_ANNUITY),
         AMT_GOODS_PRICE = if_else(is.na(AMT_GOODS_PRICE), mean(AMT_GOODS_PRICE, na.rm = TRUE), AMT_GOODS_PRICE))

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(AMT_ANNUITY = if_else(is.na(AMT_ANNUITY), mean(AMT_ANNUITY, na.rm = TRUE), AMT_ANNUITY),
         AMT_GOODS_PRICE = if_else(is.na(AMT_GOODS_PRICE), mean(AMT_GOODS_PRICE, na.rm = TRUE), AMT_GOODS_PRICE))

# Convert DAYS_BIRTH to age and bin into categories
age_bins <- c(18, 25, 35, 45, 60, Inf)
age_labels <- c("18-25", "26-35", "36-45", "46-60", "60+")
train_data$DAYS_BIRTH <- cut(abs(train_data$DAYS_BIRTH) / 365, breaks = age_bins, labels = age_labels, right = FALSE)
test_data$DAYS_BIRTH <- cut(abs(test_data$DAYS_BIRTH) / 365, breaks = age_bins, labels = age_labels, right = FALSE)

# Binary encoding for FLAG_OWN_REALTY and FLAG_OWN_CAR
train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate(FLAG_OWN_REALTY = if_else(FLAG_OWN_REALTY == "Y", 1, 0),
         FLAG_OWN_CAR = if_else(FLAG_OWN_CAR == "Y", 1, 0))

# Fill missing categorical values
columns_to_fill <- c("NAME_TYPE_SUITE", "OCCUPATION_TYPE", "FONDKAPREMONT_MODE",
                     "HOUSETYPE_MODE", "WALLSMATERIAL_MODE", "EMERGENCYSTATE_MODE")

train_data[columns_to_fill] <- lapply(train_data[columns_to_fill], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "XNA", x))

# One-hot encoding for categorical variables
train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate(CODE_GENDER = as.factor(CODE_GENDER),
         NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE = as.factor(NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE))

dummy_vars <- dummyVars(~ CODE_GENDER + NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE, data = train_data)
train_data_encoded <- predict(dummy_vars, newdata = train_data)
train_data <- cbind(as.data.frame(train_data), as.data.frame(train_data_encoded))
train_data <- train_data %>% select(-CODE_GENDER, -NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE)

# Label encode other variables
train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate(CNT_CHILDREN = as.integer(factor(CNT_CHILDREN)),
         AMT_INCOME_TOTAL = as.integer(factor(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL)),
         AMT_CREDIT = as.integer(factor(AMT_CREDIT)),
         DAYS_BIRTH = as.integer(factor(DAYS_BIRTH)),
         NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE = as.integer(factor(NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE)),
         WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START = as.integer(factor(WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START)))

# Aggregate bureau data
bureau_agg <- bureau %>%
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) %>%
  summarise(AVG_DAYS_CREDIT = mean(DAYS_CREDIT, na.rm = TRUE),
            AVG_CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE = mean(CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE, na.rm = TRUE),
            AVG_CNT_CREDIT_PROLONG = mean(CNT_CREDIT_PROLONG, na.rm = TRUE),
            AVG_AMT_CREDIT_SUM = mean(AMT_CREDIT_SUM, na.rm = TRUE),
            AVG_AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT = mean(AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT, na.rm = TRUE),
            AVG_AMT_CREDIT_SUM_OVERDUE = mean(AMT_CREDIT_SUM_OVERDUE, na.rm = TRUE))

train_data <- left_join(train_data, bureau_agg, by = "SK_ID_CURR")

# Impute missing values in numeric columns
numeric_cols <- sapply(train_data, is.numeric)
train_data[numeric_cols] <- lapply(train_data[numeric_cols], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), x))

# Split data into features (X) and target (y)
X <- train_data %>% select(-TARGET, -SK_ID_CURR)
y <- train_data$TARGET

# Train-test split (80% train, 20% test)
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
X_train <- X[train_index, ]
X_test <- X[-train_index, ]
y_train <- y[train_index]
y_test <- y[-train_index]
